constructor.details: Sets the WBNB address and the PoolAddressesProvider address. Infinite approves pool.

params.wbnb: Address of the Wrapped BNB contrac*

depositProtectedBNB(address,uint16).details: deposits pWBNB into the reserve, using native token. A corresponding amount of the overlying asset (aTokens) is minted.

params.onBehalfOf: address of the user who will receive the aTokens representing the deposit
params.referralCode: integrators are assigned a referral code and can potentially receive rewards.*

emergencyBNBTransfer(address,uint256).details: transfer native token from the utility contract, for native token recovery in case of stuck token due to selfdestructs or token transfers to the pre-computed contract address before deployment.

emergencyTokenTransfer(address,address,u.details: transfer ERC20 from the utility contract, for ERC20 recovery in case of stuck tokens due direct transfers to the contract address.

getWBNBAddress().details: Get WBNB address used by WrappedTokenGatewayV3

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.amount: amount of aWBNB to withdraw and receive native token
params.to: address of the user who will receive native token
